# The shader translator derived from shadPS4 (src/shadps4) and the host layer it builds against.
# src/shadps4 is regenerated by tools/import-shadps4, so the build description lives here.

include(FetchContent)

# The commit shadPS4 v.0.21.0 pins. Zydis brings Zycore as its submodule. Fetched and not copied
# because two generated tables are above the per-file size limit of the git hooks.
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_MAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_DOXYGEN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(zydis
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/zyantific/zydis.git
    GIT_TAG 120e0e705f8e3b507dc49377ac2879979f0d545c
    SYSTEM)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(zydis)

find_package(SPIRV-Headers REQUIRED CONFIG)
add_subdirectory(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/sirit/src ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sirit)

# The set of files is the import script's dependency closure, so it is taken as it stands. The
# renderer (video_core and the ImGui renderer core) goes into bbvideocore below, the rest is the
# translator.
set(BB_SHADPS4_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../shadps4)
file(GLOB_RECURSE BB_SHADPS4_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${BB_SHADPS4_DIR}/*.cpp)
set(BB_VIDEO_CORE_SOURCES ${BB_SHADPS4_SOURCES})
set(BB_VIDEO_CORE_REGEX
    "/(imgui|video_core/(amdgpu/(liverpool|regs)|buffer_cache|texture_cache|renderer_vulkan|cache_storage|page_manager|renderdoc))")
list(FILTER BB_SHADPS4_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX ${BB_VIDEO_CORE_REGEX})
# The system libraries of R5 (docs/design/os-libraries.md) build once their host headers exist
# (#456).
list(FILTER BB_SHADPS4_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/(core/libraries/(ajm|audio|avplayer|ime|pad|system|videodec)|input)/")
list(FILTER BB_VIDEO_CORE_SOURCES INCLUDE REGEX ${BB_VIDEO_CORE_REGEX})

add_library(bbshadps4 STATIC ${BB_SHADPS4_SOURCES} host.cpp fault_handler.cpp)
target_include_directories(bbshadps4 PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# SYSTEM, so that our own targets that include the derived headers keep their warnings on.
target_include_directories(bbshadps4 SYSTEM PUBLIC
    ${BB_SHADPS4_DIR}
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/boost
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/fmt/include
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/half/include
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/magic_enum/include
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/xbyak)
# shadPS4 is written against C++23 (std::to_underlying, std::ranges::contains).
target_compile_features(bbshadps4 PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
target_compile_definitions(bbshadps4 PUBLIC FMT_HEADER_ONLY)
target_link_libraries(bbshadps4 PUBLIC sirit Zydis PRIVATE bbcommon bb_warnings)
# Derived code stays nearly unchanged, so it builds without warnings. host.cpp is ours and keeps them.
set_source_files_properties(${BB_SHADPS4_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS -w)
# readu64 in frontend/decode.h reads 8-byte instructions at any 32-bit offset of the code, which
# x86-64 allows, and only decode.cpp calls it.
set_source_files_properties(${BB_SHADPS4_DIR}/shader_recompiler/frontend/decode.cpp PROPERTIES
    COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w;$<$<BOOL:${BB_SANITIZE}>:-fno-sanitize=alignment>")

# Libraries video_core needs (issue #427), unchanged copies in third_party/ at shadPS4's submodule
# commits. Nothing uses them yet. All are SYSTEM so that their warnings stay out of our builds.
set(BB_3P ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party)

add_library(bb_vma INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(bb_vma SYSTEM INTERFACE ${BB_3P}/vma/include)

add_library(bb_robin_map INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(bb_robin_map SYSTEM INTERFACE ${BB_3P}/robin-map/include)

add_library(bb_stb INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(bb_stb SYSTEM INTERFACE ${BB_3P}/stb)

enable_language(C)
add_library(bb_xxhash STATIC ${BB_3P}/xxhash/xxhash.c)
target_include_directories(bb_xxhash SYSTEM PUBLIC ${BB_3P}/xxhash)
set_target_properties(bb_xxhash PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99)
target_compile_options(bb_xxhash PRIVATE -w)

# Dear ImGui at shadPS4's submodule commit, fetched like Zydis: its sources hold the text "Home/End",
# which the privacy hook reads as a home path, so they can't be committed unchanged.
FetchContent_Declare(imgui_src
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/shadexternals/imgui.git
    GIT_TAG 7e1b65d26d52e9dd199d889c148c72184de647b4
    SOURCE_SUBDIR bb_no_cmake)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(imgui_src)
set(BB_IMGUI_DIR ${imgui_src_SOURCE_DIR})
add_library(bb_imgui STATIC ${BB_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui.cpp ${BB_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_draw.cpp
    ${BB_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_tables.cpp ${BB_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_widgets.cpp)
target_include_directories(bb_imgui SYSTEM PUBLIC ${BB_IMGUI_DIR})
target_compile_options(bb_imgui PRIVATE -w)
# shadPS4's ImGui config (32-bit indices, ImTextureID as a texture pointer) changes the ABI, so the
# library and everything that includes imgui.h use it. Its IM_ASSERT calls assert_fail_debug_msg,
# which video_core_host.cpp defines.
target_compile_definitions(bb_imgui PUBLIC IMGUI_USER_CONFIG="${BB_SHADPS4_DIR}/imgui/imgui_config.h")
# The Vulkan backend needs the Vulkan headers and is left out without them.
find_package(Vulkan QUIET)
if(Vulkan_FOUND)
    add_library(bb_imgui_vulkan STATIC ${BB_IMGUI_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_vulkan.cpp)
    target_include_directories(bb_imgui_vulkan SYSTEM PUBLIC ${BB_IMGUI_DIR}/backends)
    target_link_libraries(bb_imgui_vulkan PUBLIC bb_imgui Vulkan::Headers)
    target_compile_options(bb_imgui_vulkan PRIVATE -w)
endif()

add_library(bb_third_party_check STATIC third_party_check.cpp)
target_link_libraries(bb_third_party_check PUBLIC bb_vma bb_robin_map bb_stb bb_xxhash bb_imgui)

# The renderer: video_core and the ImGui renderer core on the host headers in this directory. It
# needs the Vulkan headers (the loader is opened at run time), SDL3 for the window and glslang to
# compile the host shaders. Without them it is not built.
option(BB_REQUIRE_VIDEOCORE "Fail the configure when bbvideocore cannot be built" ON)
find_program(BB_GLSLANG glslangValidator)
find_package(SDL3 CONFIG QUIET)
if(Vulkan_FOUND AND SDL3_FOUND AND BB_GLSLANG)
    # Upstream's host_shaders/CMakeLists.txt, run with the system glslang: it compiles each shader
    # into a header with the SPIR-V as an array and sets HOST_SHADERS_INCLUDE.
    set(GLSLANG_COMPILER ${BB_GLSLANG})
    add_subdirectory(${BB_SHADPS4_DIR}/video_core/host_shaders ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/host_shaders)

    # cache_storage.cpp is the pipeline cache's storage, which needs miniz and stays off until R8.
    # renderdoc.cpp loads RenderDoc. video_core_host.cpp replaces both with fixed no-ops.
    list(FILTER BB_VIDEO_CORE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/video_core/(cache_storage|renderdoc)\\.cpp$")
    # memory.cpp builds guest memory on the kernel's vmem and dmem, so every executable that links
    # bbvideocore also links bbhle (an OBJECT library, which only executables link).
    add_library(bbvideocore STATIC ${BB_VIDEO_CORE_SOURCES} memory.cpp video_core_host.cpp
        sdl_window.cpp imgui_impl_sdl3.cpp)
    add_dependencies(bbvideocore host_shaders)
    target_include_directories(bbvideocore SYSTEM PUBLIC ${HOST_SHADERS_INCLUDE})
    # Boost's pool/singleton_pool.hpp (for range_set.h) comes from the commit of third_party/boost
    # here, not from the tree: see tools/import-shadps4/boost-headers.txt.
    set(BB_BOOST_FETCHED ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/boost_fetched)
    file(DOWNLOAD
        https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shadps4-emu/ext-boost/ca6f230e67be7cc45fc919057f07b2aee64dadc1/boost/pool/singleton_pool.hpp
        ${BB_BOOST_FETCHED}/boost/pool/singleton_pool.hpp
        EXPECTED_HASH SHA256=da873b7c64a6241e32d219d4fd667a7dca12a93ba978e11ffde2e9cc73cbf796
        TLS_VERIFY ON)
    target_include_directories(bbvideocore SYSTEM PUBLIC ${BB_BOOST_FETCHED})
    target_link_libraries(bbvideocore
        PUBLIC bbshadps4 bb_vma bb_robin_map bb_stb bb_xxhash bb_imgui Vulkan::Headers SDL3::SDL3
        PRIVATE bbcommon bb_warnings ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
    # Liverpool reads the PM4 packet structs, some with 64-bit members, at any dword of a command
    # buffer, which x86-64 allows.
    set_source_files_properties(${BB_VIDEO_CORE_SOURCES} PROPERTIES
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w;$<$<BOOL:${BB_SANITIZE}>:-fno-sanitize=alignment>")
else()
    # CI installs all three, so a missing one there would silently drop the video_core tests.
    # Set BB_REQUIRE_VIDEOCORE=OFF to configure without the renderer.
    if(BB_REQUIRE_VIDEOCORE)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Vulkan headers, SDL3 or glslangValidator not found: bbvideocore "
                            "cannot be built (-DBB_REQUIRE_VIDEOCORE=OFF configures without it)")
    endif()
    message(STATUS "Vulkan headers, SDL3 or glslangValidator not found: bbvideocore is not built")
endif()
